div.p: Storm readiness · Tidal Gate basin network · 14 six-hour intervals · three pump stations · field telemetry export 2026-09-22 06:00. Marsh 4 carried the highest sustained load and vibration spread, while East Sluice telemetry stayed below the intake threshold after a sensor swap. One high-load interval is disputed between the supervisory historian and a local counter. Deploy two stations now and hold Marsh 4 for a bearing check; this report does not infer storm intensity from pump duty alone.
